description: OW-07 orphan ratchet exceptions (scripts/check_orphans.ts). Each entry is a reviewed, intentional exception with the reason it is kept (wave-3 triage, ORPHAN_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md); placeholder 'backlog' reasons are rejected.
